Also possibly "非法持有毒品罪" but he had large amount and sold, so trafficking covers. Also "滥用职权" maybe. But typical Chinese criminal law: police officer who hides drug evidence and sells is charged with "贩卖毒品罪" and "徇私枉法罪".
